description.short: Microsoft Agent Framework assistant for Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
description.full: Chat in Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot with an Azure-hosted Microsoft Agent Framework assistant. It can answer questions and call a read-only UTC time tool. Microsoft Graph access is not configured.

commands.title: What can you help me with?
commands.description: Explain the assistant's capabilities and limitations.

commands.title: What is the current UTC time?
commands.description: Call the read-only UTC time tool.

commands.title: Can you access my files?
commands.description: Explain which data sources are and are not connected.

disclaimer.text: AI-generated answers may be inaccurate. This demo does not access your Microsoft 365 files. Do not submit sensitive information.
